title: 2027 Audit Graduate Programme - Dublin
description: **Graduate Programme 2027 – Audit** Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme. **About Grant Thornton** Grant Thornton is one of Ireland's leading professional services firms, with nearly 3,000 people and a global network spanning more than 145 countries. We combine local expertise with international insight to help clients solve complex challenges and achieve sustainable growth. **Audit** **About the Team** Grant Thornton's Audit practice provides independent assurance services to organisations across a wide range of industries, helping stakeholders make informed business decisions with confidence. Our professionals combine technical expertise, commercial understanding and industry knowledge to deliver high\-quality audits that go beyond compliance. The Audit practice comprises **Corporate Audit, Financial Services (FS) Audit and Global Statutory Audit** teams, providing graduates with exposure to a diverse range of industries, organisations and audit environments. **Corporate Audit** works with clients ranging from large multinational corporations and listed entities to privately owned businesses and rapidly growing entrepreneurial companies. **Financial Services (FS) Audit** supports a broad range of regulated entities, including investment funds, asset managers, aircraft leasing companies, banking institutions and insurance businesses. **Global Statutory Audit** works with multinational organisations to coordinate statutory audit requirements across multiple jurisdictions, collaborating with Grant Thornton member firms around the world to deliver seamless and consistent audit services. Our professionals support clients across a variety of sectors, including: * Technology * Financial Services * Aviation and Leasing * Manufacturing * Healthcare and Life Sciences * Retail and Consumer Business * Real Estate and Construction Energy and Infrastructure * As an Audit Graduate, you'll gain hands\-on experience from day one, working with a diverse portfolio of clients and developing a deep understanding of how businesses operate. You'll have the opportunity to build strong technical accounting and auditing knowledge while gaining valuable insight into the financial and operational drivers behind business performance. Whether working with large multinational organisations, indigenous Irish businesses, high\-growth companies or public interest entities, you'll contribute to engagements that help build trust and confidence in financial reporting. **What You Will Do** As a Graduate Trainee within Audit, you'll work closely with experienced auditors and client teams on a variety of audit and assurance engagements across Corporate Audit, FS Audit and Global Statutory Audit. You may have the opportunity to: * Assist in planning and executing financial statement audits. * Review financial records, business processes and internal controls. * Analyse financial data and assess audit risks. * Prepare audit working papers and supporting documentation. * Perform substantive testing across key financial statement areas. * Participate in stock counts and other audit procedures. * Support the identification and assessment of control weaknesses and business risks. * Work directly with clients to gather information and understand their operations. * Prepare reports, presentations and client deliverables. Collaborate with colleagues across Audit, Tax and Advisory teams. * **The Experience You Will Gain** You'll gain practical experience working with businesses of varying sizes and complexities while developing a strong understanding of accounting standards, regulatory requirements and audit methodology. **How We Will Support Your Development** At Grant Thornton, we are committed to helping our people realise their potential. As an Audit Graduate, you'll benefit from: * Structured learning and development programmes. * Professional qualification support through ACA training. * Dedicated mentoring and coaching. * Technical accounting and audit training. * Study leave and exam support. * Opportunities to work directly with senior stakeholders and client management teams. * Access to The Academy training programme. Clear pathways for long\-term career progression and leadership development. * Our culture encourages curiosity, innovation and continuous improvement, giving graduates the support and opportunities needed to build successful careers in professional services. **Who We're Looking For** We welcome applications from graduates across a broad range of disciplines who are interested in business, finance and professional services. Successful candidates will demonstrate: * Strong IT, analytical and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. * Attention to detail and a commitment to quality. * Curiosity about how businesses operate. * A proactive and collaborative mindset. * Strong organisational and time management skills. * The ability to analyse information critically and think commercially. A minimum 2\.1 degree, or expected equivalent, in any discipline. * **It would also be helpful if you have** * Experience gained through an internship, part\-time role, volunteering, university society or team\-based project. An interest in how organisations change, improve services or make better use of technology * **Join Us** Join Grant Thornton's Audit team and gain exposure to some of Ireland's most dynamic organisations across Corporate Audit, Financial Services Audit and Global Statutory Audit. You'll develop technical expertise, commercial insight and professional skills while helping businesses maintain transparency, accountability and trust. **Location and working arrangement:** Dublin office, primarily office\-based. **Application and selection process:** Apply through link \- complete our application form and upload your current CV. Closing date Thursday 22 October 2026\. Selection process early November 2026\. Start date Autumn 2027\. **Real Opportunities with Grant Thornton's Graduate Programme.** \#LI\-KS1

title: AI Builder, Emerging Talent - French Market
description: *To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.* **About Futureforce University Recruiting** Our Futureforce University Recruiting program is dedicated to attracting, retaining and cultivating talent. With offices all over the world, our recruits have the chance to collaborate and connect with fellow employees on a global scale. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. **AI Builder, Emerging Talent \- French Market** Technical foundation required. Builder mindset non\-negotiable. Salesforce is hiring AI Builders, people who are early in their career but not early in their ambition. As part of our first\-of\-its\-kind **AI Builder New Grad cohort** , you'll be embedded directly with customer\-facing teams, designing, developing, and deploying **Agentic solutions** for the world’s Fortune 500\. We are at the beginning of the agentic era, and you will be at the keyboard building the solutions that define how the world's largest companies operate. You’ll deliver real\-time customer impact from day one. Working in a builder pod, a cross\-functional team that collaborates to design, build, and deploy AI solutions for real customers. It's a built\-in support system to ensure you're set up to win. Honestly, you're already thinking about what you'd build here… **The AI Builder Experience** * AI\-Powered Development: You'll be developing real customer solutions with the best\-in\-class suite of leading\-edge AI tools: Including Cursor, Claude, and our coding products like Vibes, to accelerate development. * Dedicated Mentorship: You won’t be building in a vacuum. You’ll be part of a program focused on hands\-on technical skill development, shadowing opportunities, and meaningful networking. You’ll be paired with a dedicated onboarding buddy and have the opportunity to partner with senior developers. * Skill Acceleration: This role is designed to develop both your technical depth and your sales skills, ensuring you can lead high\-level conversations with stakeholders. **What You'll Actually Be Building** * Develop AI agents that take real actions for real companies. This is not a side project. Agentforce is live, in production, running for some of the biggest companies on the planet. * Design Agent Intelligence: Design how agents think: prompts, reasoning, tool calls, and the entire architecture, leveraging AI/LLM technologies and the Agentforce platform. * Support the entire Technical Lifecycle: Collaborate with other Builders to architect, build, debug, and deploy high\-quality, scalable production systems using JavaScript, Python, and Apex. * Drive Strategic Impact: Partner with clients to turn business challenges into agentic solutions. You’ll use your consultative skills to ensure our tech meets real\-world needs * Iterate and Deploy: Test it, break it, fix it, ship it. Repeat. You will own your work from day one. **You’re Our Builder If…** * You have a strong background in Computer Science or a related engineering discipline. * You’re an AI native who has been deep in LLMs and prompt engineering. * You are fluent in React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Python, OOP and Real\-Time Infra * You can hold your own in a room with our sales teams and customers. * You write high\-quality code and evaluate AI outputs with engineering rigor. * You thrive in the group chat that’s building something, not just talking about it. * You're ready to grow faster here than anywhere else \- nobody has 10 years of experience in this new frontier, which means your ideas carry real weight from day one. * You bring sharp problem\-solving instincts, relentless initiative, and a get\-things\-done mentality. * You are excited to travel 25\-50% of the time, working directly alongside our customers to see your code come to life in their environments. * Fluency required in French and English Unleash Your Potential When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world. Accommodations If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. ********Posting Statement******** Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non\-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Architectural Graduate
description: **Company Description** JFOC Architects is a design\-led practice specialising in housing. The office has a research\-based ethos with an interest in how low\-cost housing can be carefully designed to provide excellent public realm and a strong sense of place. JFOC has helped deliver over 9,000 dwellings since 1987\. Dominic Stevens Architects, an award winning practice, merged with JFOC Architects in 2016 and this has led to the greater focus on research within the office. This research has led to the development of new housing typologies which are now under construction. **Role Description** A Talented Architectural Graduate with an interest in working on Live construction projects is required by JFOC Architects for its practice in Harold’s Cross. This role will allow you to work on projects from planning consent stage through to construction and completion. **Ideal candidate will have:** \- 2 years \+ post graduate experience \- Have experience working on tender / construction stages in Ireland \- Knowledge of Irish building regulations \- Proficient in AutoCAD and Sketchup \- Knowledge of Revit and 3D rendering beneficial. \- Strong Communication and organization skills **What we offer:** JFOC Architects has a fully transparent salary scale which will be provided to candidates following an interview. Career progression and professional development is encouraged and fully supported by the practice. A supportive office environment and work\-life balance are central to the practice ethos. The standard office hours are 9am to 6pm from Monday to Thursday and from 9am to 1pm on Fridays. Excellent terms and conditions, dependent on skills and experience, offering strong career development opportunities within a strong and supportive architectural team. **How to apply:** Apply via to our email address info@jfocarchitects.com. Please include CV and your Portfolio. *JFOC Architects is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring on the basis of sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.* Pay: Up to €40,000\.00 per year Benefits: * On\-site parking Work Location: In person

title: Associate Systems Administrator
description: **Who We Are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we’re the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we’ve been profitable for over 15 years. **What We Do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role Overview** The Associate Systems Administrator is an entry\-level position within the IT Systems team based in our Dublin office. This role serves as a critical bridge between our IT Service Desk and Global Systems functions, primarily focusing on supporting our EU and UK\-based employees. You will work closely with the IT Service Desk team to resolve technical escalations while aligning with US\-based systems engineers to maintain global applications, security policies, patching standards, and network infrastructure across our European locations. This role requires a blend of operational support, technical curiosity, and a commitment to maintaining a secure, highly available environment. On Call work may be required with this roll as needed by the business. In addition to the responsibilities above, this role also requires regular physical activity, including moving around the office to assist with IT or AV event related tasks, lifting and carrying equipment (upwards of 50lbs), moving tables and chairs, and plugging in devices under desks and other confined spaces. The Associate Systems Administrator must be able to perform these duties safely and efficiently as part of their responsibilities. **What You'll Do** **System Administration \& Support** * Perform daily monitoring, management, and troubleshooting for core corporate enterprise software platforms. * Assist with the configuration, deployment, and maintenance of identity platforms and collaboration tools. * Follow established change management procedures for system updates and modifications. * Maintain accurate system documentation, including runbooks and knowledge base articles for the Service Desk. **Workspace \& Endpoint Management** * Support the administration of Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Jamf and Microsoft Intune. * Assist in managing end\-user devices, including software deployments, VDI deployment and desktop configurations. * Help implement and enforce security measures like software patches and OS updates. **Networking \& Infrastructure** * Provide first\-level support for network escalations, including Wi\-Fi, VPN, and firewall issues. * Assist with basic network troubleshooting and performance monitoring for EU office environments. * Support the setup and maintenance of local network hardware under senior guidance. **Identity \& Security Compliance** * Manage user lifecycles within identity platforms (e.g., Okta) to ensure appropriate access controls. * Contribute to incident response efforts by participating in a regional on\-call rotation. * Review incoming IT requests to ensure alignment with company Information Security and governance policies. **What You'll Bring** **Required Skills \& Experience** * Foundational experience with Identity and Access Management (IAM) platforms such as Okta or OneLogin. * Proficiency working within enterprise ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian/Jira). * Experience with enterprise collaboration tools including Google Workspace, Microsoft O365, and Slack. * Exposure to MDM tools such as Microsoft Intune or Jamf. * Basic understanding of enterprise networking principles and troubleshooting techniques.Demonstrated ability to document technical processes and follow standard operating procedures. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Audiovisual (AV) setup and troubleshooting for conference rooms. * Basic administration experience with enterprise cloud\-based telephony systems (e.g., Dialpad). * A background in Systems Administration (min 2 years experience) and some experience with IT support or service desk operations. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across time zones. The displayed range represents the expected annual base salary / On\-Target Earnings (OTE) for this position. On\-Target Earnings (OTE) is inclusive of base salary and on\-target commission earnings, which applies exclusively to sales roles. Individual pay within this range is determined by work location and other factors such as job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. This annual base salary forms part of a comprehensive Total Rewards Package. In addition to benefits, this role may qualify for discretionary bonuses/incentives and Restricted Stock Units (RSUs). Position Pay Range €38\.000—€48\.000 EUR **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus’ curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. title: Healthcare Assistant - Inpatient Ward - UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic Dublin
description: Location: UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic Dublin Job type: Full\-time Contract of Employment **Overview Of Role** The role of the Health Care Assistant is to assist the Nursing Staff in the delivery of patient care, under the supervision of the Clinical Nurse Managers and Staff Nurses. The primary role is to assist nurses with nursing care and associated duties. **Primary Duties And Responsibilities** Distribute sputum and denture cartons to patients as required and ensure denture cartons are labelled appropriately. Remain with patients who require observation, following assessment by nursing staff. Deal with patient’s personal property. Take care of patient’s dentures, glasses and hearing aids. Receive patients and visitors to the wards with courtesy. Answer telephones (please see telephone etiquette) and locate appropriate personnel when necessary. Answer call bells, deal with appropriate requests, and report other requests to nursing staff.Check that bells are in working order and are within the reach of the patient. Clean and assemble equipment as required e.g. trolleys, drip stands, etc Assist with the disposal of clinical waste and clean procedure trolleys daily. Make occupied and unoccupied beds and cots and turn mattresses on weekly basis. Move beds and furniture within wards as required. Attend to spillages immediately to reduce the risk of accidents. Ensure linen cupboard and store areas are kept tidy and stocked. Assist patients to dress and pack in preparation for discharge. Restock aprons and gloves in clinical areas. Keep emergency exits clear at all times i.e. ensure chairs are stored appropriately after visiting hours. Help prepare the ward for cleaning. Ensure that sluice room, bathrooms, toilets and other ancillary rooms are kept clean and tidy, in the interest of patient care and Health and Safety requirements. Assist in keeping the ward areas and day room tidy. Carry out errands as requested by Clinical Nurse Managers or Deputies e.g. collect faxes/charts, patient errands within the clinic, pharmacy, stores, laboratory and errands to other wards. Report broken items in need of repair to the Clinical Nurse Manager. Wash all patients’ basins daily, also drip stands, fans, feeding pumps and other equipment as required. Report to nursing staff any complaints of pain, distress or needs expressed by patients. Assist other support staff with storage of CSSD and stores. Assist the transport team transport patients to and from Theatre. Work as a Covid\-19 swabbing HCA in the Test Centre. **Qualifications \& Experience** * Possess a good standard of education * FETAC Level 5 essential * Previous experience of working in a caring profession is desirable. * Have the ability to work on own initiative, prioritise and manage a number of issues simultaneously and demonstrate attention to detail. * Have the ability to undertake the physical demands of the role. * Be motivated and able to identify potential difficulties and formulate solutions. * Be free from any defect or disease which would render him/her unsuitable to hold office and be in a state of health as would indicate a reasonable prospect of ability to render regular and efficient service. * Be of good character. This job description is intended to be an outline of the areas of responsibility. As UPMC and the post holder develop, this job description may be subject to review in light of the changing needs of the business. **Equal Opportunity Statement And Benefits** **UPMC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.** At UPMC we provide a total rewards program that is not only market competitive, but fair and provides growth opportunities for all our colleagues. **Performance and Recognition** – Rewards for performance that supports the goals and mission of UPMC through our annual ACES programme. **Development and Career Opportunities** – Opportunities for each employee to reach their career goals through continued learning and/or advancement. **About UPMC** UPMC is a renowned multinational academic medical centre committed to delivering people\-focused care that’s close to home. Headquartered in Pittsburgh and affiliated with the University of Pittsburgh Schools of the Health Sciences, UPMC shapes the future of health through clinical and technological innovation, research and education. UPMC expands its expertise globally, bringing world\-class care across continents through its UPMC International division — an owned and operated network of hospitals and ambulatory care centres in Italy, Ireland and Croatia. UPMC International brings new access to the signature specialty services of UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre, UPMC Sports Medicine and others to more people in more places around the world. In Ireland UPMC has provided high\-quality healthcare in the South East since 2006\. UPMC’s operations in Ireland now include UPMC Whitfield Hospital in Waterford, UPMC Sports Surgery Clinic in Dublin, UPMC Kildare Hospital in Clane, and UPMC Aut Even Hospital in Kilkenny. Outpatient care is available at the UPMC Carlow Outreach Centre, UPMC Hillman Cancer Centre radiotherapy locations in Waterford and Cork, UPMC The 4th Practice in Mallow, and across UPMC Sports Medicine Clinics in Dublin, Waterford, Limerick, Tipperary, Cork, and Mayo. title: Junior Mechanical Estimator
description: **Role purpose** To take full ownership of the quotation workstream, from the moment an enquiry arrives to the issue of a complete, professional quotation pack to the customer. The successful candidate will become the single accountable person for this process running it day to day, improving how it works and being the point of contact internally and externally for the status of any live quotation. The role suits an engineering or building services graduate with two to three years in a merchant, contractor or manufacturer environment, who wants to build a career in estimating within heat pumps and renewable heating. **Key responsibilities** Enquiry intake and qualification * Acknowledge every enquiry the same working day and ensure nothing sits unassigned. * Review incoming drawings and mechanical specifications to establish what falls within our scope and what does not. * Apply the agreed go / no\-go criteria and decline enquiries outside our core business promptly and courteously, without progressing them to pricing. * Work to an agreed timeframe for specification review, escalating to the senior team member where a judgement call is needed rather than absorbing the time alone. **Technical coordination** * Determine whether a job requires a quick quote or a full SR50 calculation and sign\-off, applying the agreed rule, and arrange third\-party sign\-off where required. * Submit underfloor heating projects to our supplier for design, manage the turnaround, and check the returned design against the enquiry before it goes to the customer. * Produce or check radiator schedules and emitter sizing for low\-temperature systems. * Chase all outstanding technical inputs and customer responses so that no job stalls unnoticed. **Sourcing and pricing** * Identify items not held in stock and obtain competitive supplier pricing, running more than one quotation where value justifies it. * Apply agreed margins and pricing rules consistently, and follow the agreed convention for items not set up on the ERP system. **Quotation production and issue** * Produce quotations in ERP system to the agreed standard. * Assemble and issue a single, branded quotation pack containing the priced schedule, scope and exclusions, underfloor heating design, radiator schedule, SR50 calculation and product specification sheets as applicable. * Ensure quotations state clearly what has been priced against our own scope, and where elements of a customer’s specification have been excluded or interpreted. * Never pass a supplier’s own quotation directly to a customer. **Tracking, reporting and follow\-up** * Maintain the quotation tracker so that the status of every live enquiry is visible without having to ask: date received, qualification outcome, quote type, dates sent to and returned from third parties, outstanding information, date quoted, value and outcome. * Follow up issued quotations and record won, lost and the reason. * Report weekly on volume, turnaround time, conversion and any bottlenecks. **Improving the process** * Own and maintain the quotation template, standard inclusions and exclusions wording, and the product specification sheet library. * Identify recurring causes of delay or rework and propose changes. * Build a set of standard pricing for common configurations to shorten turnaround on repeat job types. **Knowledge, skills and experience** * A qualification in mechanical or building services engineering, energy or a closely related discipline, or equivalent practical experience in heating and plumbing supply or installation. * Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings and specifications, and to carry out a take\-off from them. * A working understanding of hydronic heating systems: heat sources, emitters, pipework, pumps, cylinders and basic controls and zoning. * Sound numeracy and strong attention to detail, this role prices work that the business is then committed to. * Competent with Excel and comfortable learning quotation and ERP software along with adoption of AI. * Clear, professional written English for customer\-facing correspondence. * Organised and self\-directed, able to run a pipeline of concurrent enquiries at different stages without supervision. **Desirable** * Familiarity with heat pump sizing, heat loss calculation and the SR50 process. * Knowledge of underfloor heating design principles: circuit layout, pipe spacing, manifolds and flow temperatures. * Awareness of SEAI grant schemes, BER and retrofit advisory reports. * Exposure to solar, boilers or wider mechanical services. **Personal attributes** * Takes ownership rather than waiting to be directed. This role exists because the process currently has no owner. * Comfortable saying no to work that falls outside our scope, and explaining why. * Persistent in chasing suppliers, third parties and customers for the information needed to quote. * Willing to challenge a specification or an assumption where the numbers do not look right. Pay: €45,000\.00\-€55,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Bike to work scheme * Company pension * Employee assistance program * On\-site parking * Sick pay * Work from home Education: * Bachelor's (preferred) Experience: * Construction estimating: 1 year (preferred) Work Location: In person

description: **QC Laboratory Technician** Quality is not simply a final check. It is built through accurate testing, sound judgement and consistent attention to detail. We are looking for a QC Laboratory Technician to help safeguard the quality and safety of WaterWipes products. This is a hands\-on laboratory role for someone who takes ownership of their work, respects the importance of data integrity and knows when to act or escalate. You will join our Quality team in Drogheda and perform microbiological and quality control testing within WaterWipes’ in\-house laboratory. Your work will help ensure that raw materials, finished products and supporting processes meet our internal, customer and regulatory requirements. You will also support product trials, laboratory investigations, audit readiness and improvements to how we work. This opportunity will suit someone who enjoys practical laboratory work and understands that accurate testing and complete documentation directly support product quality, consumer safety and business decisions. Success means delivering reliable results within agreed timelines, maintaining clear and complete records, identifying issues early and providing dependable technical support to colleagues across the business. **What You’ll Be Accountable For** * Performing environmental monitoring, water monitoring, microbial limit testing and other quality control testing in line with approved methods. * Testing raw materials and finished products using aseptic techniques and safe working practices. * Supporting method qualification and validation for new and existing products. * Operating, calibrating and maintaining laboratory equipment to produce accurate and reliable results. * Supporting Innovation and Technical teams with trials, process simulations and microbiological or analytical testing. * Preparing samples for analysis by external laboratories when required. * Maintaining accurate laboratory records, reports, logs and quality documentation. * Recording non\-conformances and supporting root\-cause investigations and corrective actions. * Providing laboratory data and technical input for customer complaint investigations. * Supporting internal, customer and third\-party audits. * Contributing to improvements in laboratory procedures, SOPs and safe systems of work. * Managing laboratory consumables and maintaining a safe, organised and compliant working environment. **Who This Role Is For** This role is for someone with a bachelor’s degree in Microbiology or another relevant scientific discipline and at least one year’s experience working in a GLP laboratory environment. You will need practical experience in microbiological or quality control testing, including the use of aseptic techniques. Experience gained within manufacturing, FMCG, pharmaceuticals or medical devices would be particularly relevant.
